objects.summary: Multi-Source Ideation V2 exact-head implementation 7d7c7af5... is independently qualified by run 39673124384 with 1090 tests discovered, zero network requests and verified tree digest. Comment explicitly warns not to infer Wave2 integration from isolated lane qualification.

Owner scopes WP1 continuation to the smallest BitMEX offline source-contract blocker. No live probe, historical rerun, successor invention, C1-C4 reopening or broad infrastructure build; preserved primary evidence and dependency-limited requalification are required.

Codex returns BLOCK because supplied checkout is shallow and lacks the assigned commit/evidence bytes. It explicitly avoids inferring repository absence, records 27 fields, and identifies restoring accessible history as the only next lawful action.

Owner independently verifies remote branch/head and reclassifies prior result as environment-limited, instructing continuation only if exact remote history becomes accessible and requiring explicit distinction between repository absence and environment inability.

Codex returns WP1_CONTINUATION_RESULT=BLOCK_ENVIRONMENT: required commit inaccessible in shallow checkout, no remote/fetch path; no broader search, live probe, rerun, speculative repair or code mutation is performed.

GitHub-native evidence path is restored. Historical metadata proves an authoritative Swagger download receipt (197079 bytes, exact SHA) and preserves RIGHTS_CONTRADICTION_WAIT, but the Swagger payload bytes themselves are not yet present in the cited metadata/catalogue evidence.

Codex revises verdict to BLOCK_EVIDENCE_ABSENT_OR_UNRECOVERED after bounded remote evidence search. Receipt/hash is preserved but exact Swagger bytes are unrecovered; 410 available blobs do not match the Swagger SHA. Timestamp/symbol/units/provenance/admission/PIT remain unresolved; no successor or outcome access.

cross_object_findings.finding: Multi-Source Ideation V2 is strongly qualified at exact head, but the source itself warns that this does not establish Wave2 integration. Qualification and convergence remain distinct.
WP1 initially blocks because the runtime cannot reach required history. Owner correction prevents that environment limitation from being misreported as missing repository evidence.

Historical BitMEX Swagger receipt/hash proves a payload was downloaded, but not its field semantics. Without preserved payload bytes, source contract, timestamp, precision, provenance and PIT cannot be lawfully upgraded to PASS.
The continuation repeatedly stops at the smallest unresolved evidence gap instead of rerunning the trial, probing live data or constructing generic infrastructure.
